items.title: bills-allocate-batch checks the caller's own accepted membership and needs accountant or higher to change allocations

verified.head: bbdacc04f04a6da223f6fd695654ec508b6df3d0
verified.note: auth.ts runs before any query or RPC: authorizeOrgCaller with an empty service key (the service path can never match), the user is resolved by auth.getUser(jwt), and the caller's OWN row is read (.eq user_id + organization_id; unique index on the pair) with accepted_at and role_enum ranking: stats viewer+, rematch/auto_accept/full accountant+. A machine token or the anon key gets 401. The RPCs it calls (rematch_unallocated_bills, bulk_accept_job_suggestions) run with the caller's JWT and now need accountant via can_write_org (SEC-10), so the edge and SQL gates agree for direct members. deno check clean. Residual: agency owners/admins without a direct membership in the sub-account now get 403 even though the SQL RPCs admit them; the 500 path still returns detail: String(err).

items.title: accountant-email-query matches the sender's accepted accountant memberships by role_enum, so the emailed activity digest works

verified.head: bbdacc04f04a6da223f6fd695654ec508b6df3d0
verified.note: Confirmed the legacy role column is enum membership_role (owner/admin/manager/member), so the old .eq('role','accountant') could never match. New path: x-inbound-secret checked first (fail closed), sender found across listUsers pages (stops on a short page, throws above 100k users), then only that user's rows with role_enum='accountant' and accepted_at not null (filtered in the query and again in acceptedAccountantMemberships); the activity query is scoped to the chosen org and that user. deno check clean. Residual (pre-existing, now live because matching works): the sender is identified only by the unauthenticated From header (no SPF/DKIM check in code) and the reply goes to the raw From string, not the matched user's registered address; a spoofed From gets the real accountant's digest mailed to whatever Resend makes of that string. Replying to the registered email of the matched user would close it.
